examples.en: What time is it now?
This is my first time on a plane.

mnemonic.tip: What time…? 问几点；three times 三次；on time 准时。

examples.en: The postman comes at nine every day.
The postman brought a parcel for you.
examples.zh: 邮递员给你送来一个包裹。

mnemonic.tip: post(邮件)+man(人)→送邮件的人，就是邮递员。

examples.en: The businessman travels a lot for work.
Her father is a busy businessman.
examples.zh: 她父亲是个忙碌的商人。

mnemonic.tip: business(生意)+man→做生意的人；女商人 businesswoman。

examples.en: He wants to be a famous footballer.
examples.zh: 他想成为著名的足球运动员。

examples.en: The footballer scored three goals.

mnemonic.tip: football+er→踢足球的人；同类：swimmer、runner。

examples.en: The photographer took our class photo.
examples.zh: 摄影师拍了我们的班级合影。

examples.en: She works as a photographer for a magazine.

mnemonic.tip: photograph(照片)+er→拍照片的人；注意重音在 to：pho-TO-grapher。

examples.en: The school secretary answered the phone.
Leave a message with my secretary.
examples.zh: 请把留言告诉我的秘书。

mnemonic.tip: secret(秘密)+ary→帮老板守着"秘密"文件的人，就是秘书。

examples.en: We took the sick puppy to the vet.
examples.zh: 我们带生病的小狗去看了兽医。

examples.en: The vet said the cat needs medicine.

mnemonic.tip: vet 是 veterinarian 的简称：动物们的 doctor。

collocations: take the dog to the vet

examples.en: The cleaners work before school opens.
Please thank the cleaner for her hard work.
examples.zh: 请感谢清洁阿姨的辛勤劳动。

mnemonic.tip: clean(打扫)+er→打扫的人，就是清洁工。

examples.en: The shopkeeper gave me my change.
The friendly shopkeeper knows everyone.
examples.zh: 友善的店主认识每一个人。

mnemonic.tip: shop(店)+keeper(看守人)→守着店的人，就是店主。

examples.en: The musicians played in the square.
She is a talented young musician.
examples.zh: 她是一位有才华的年轻音乐家。

mnemonic.tip: music(音乐)+ian(从事…的人)→搞音乐的人；同类 magician 魔术师。

examples.en: Dad's boss is very kind.
The boss gave everyone a day off.
examples.zh: 老板给每个人放了一天假。

mnemonic.tip: boss 音译"老板"的"波士"：香港话把老板叫波士。

examples.en: The workers are building a new bridge.
examples.zh: 工人们正在修建一座新桥。

examples.en: My mother is an office worker.

mnemonic.tip: work(工作)+er→工作的人；office worker 上班族。

examples.en: The firefighters put out the fire quickly.
examples.zh: 消防员很快扑灭了大火。

examples.en: Firefighters are very brave.

mnemonic.tip: fire(火)+fighter(战士)→和火战斗的人，就是消防员。

examples.en: The king lived in a great palace.
examples.zh: 国王住在宏伟的宫殿里。

examples.en: The lion is the king of animals.
The queen wore a golden crown.
The bee queen is bigger than other bees.

mnemonic.tip: 扑克牌里的 Q 就是 queen；K 是 king。

examples.en: The prince helped the poor farmer.
examples.zh: 王子帮助了贫穷的农夫。

examples.en: The story is about a young prince.
examples.zh: 这个故事讲的是一位年轻的王子。

examples.en: The princess lived in a high tower.
My little sister loves princess stories.

mnemonic.tip: prince+ess(女性后缀)→女王子，就是公主；同类 waitress。

examples.en: The painter drew the old bridge by the river.
The painters painted our classroom white.
examples.zh: 油漆工把我们教室刷成了白色。

mnemonic.tip: paint(画/刷)+er→既是画家也是油漆工。

examples.en: She is the fastest swimmer in our school.
examples.zh: 她是我们学校游得最快的人。

examples.en: Swimmers must shower before the pool.
examples.zh: 游泳者下水前必须淋浴。

mnemonic.tip: swim+mer(双写m)→游泳的人。

examples.en: A hundred runners joined the race.
examples.zh: 一百名跑者参加了比赛。

examples.en: The fastest runner won a gold medal.
examples.zh: 跑得最快的人赢得了金牌。

mnemonic.tip: run+ner(双写n)→跑步的人。

examples.en: This swimming class is for beginners.
examples.zh: 这个游泳班是给初学者的。

examples.en: She skates well for a beginner.
examples.zh: 作为初学者，她滑得不错了。

mnemonic.tip: begin(开始)+ner→刚开始学的人，就是初学者。

examples.en: The melon is sweet and juicy.
We bought a melon at the market.
examples.zh: 我们在集市上买了一个甜瓜。

mnemonic.tip: watermelon(西瓜) 去掉 water 就是 melon(甜瓜)。

examples.en: Coconuts grow on tall trees by the beach.
examples.zh: 椰子长在海边的高树上。

examples.en: I drank coconut water on the island.

mnemonic.tip: coco(可可般的壳)+nut(坚果)→长着硬壳的大"坚果"，就是椰子。

examples.en: Dad made a cheese omelette for breakfast.
examples.zh: 爸爸早餐做了奶酪煎蛋卷。

examples.en: You need three eggs for this omelette.
examples.zh: 做这个煎蛋卷需要三个鸡蛋。

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"奥姆莱"：西餐厅菜单上的煎蛋卷就叫奥姆莱。

examples.en: We eat pancakes with honey.
Mum can throw a pancake in the air!
examples.zh: 妈妈会把煎饼抛到空中翻面！

mnemonic.tip: pan(平底锅)+cake(饼)→平底锅里摊的饼，就是煎饼。

examples.en: Peas are small, green and round.
We had fish with peas and chips.
examples.zh: 我们吃了鱼配豌豆和薯条。

mnemonic.tip: pea 和字母 P 同音：豌豆小得像一个个小 P。

examples.en: Rabbits love eating cabbage.
Grandma grows cabbages in her garden.
examples.zh: 奶奶在园子里种卷心菜。

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"卡白菜"：卷心菜就是一层层卡在一起的"白菜"。

examples.en: We always buy popcorn at the cinema.
examples.zh: 我们看电影总买爆米花。

examples.en: The popcorn smells so good!

mnemonic.tip: pop(砰)+corn(玉米)→"砰"一声爆开的玉米，就是爆米花。

examples.en: The children got candy at the party.
examples.zh: 孩子们在聚会上得到了糖果。

examples.en: Too much candy is bad for your teeth.

mnemonic.tip: 美式 candy = 英式 sweets；candy 音近"糖的"。

examples.en: Chicken curry with rice is delicious.
The curry is a little hot for me.
examples.zh: 这个咖喱对我来说有点辣。

mnemonic.tip: curry 音译就是"咖喱"，直接从英语借来的词。

examples.en: I had a bread roll with butter.
examples.zh: 我吃了一个抹黄油的小圆面包。

examples.en: The ball rolled under the car.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：滚圆的小面包，和"滚动"的动作——面包就是滚圆的。

examples.en: There is a cherry on top of the cake.
Cherries are expensive in winter.

mnemonic.tip: cherry 音译"车厘子"：车厘子就是樱桃的粤语音译。

examples.en: We need flour and eggs to make pancakes.
examples.zh: 做煎饼需要面粉和鸡蛋。

examples.en: His hands were white with flour.
examples.zh: 他的手上沾满了白面粉。

mnemonic.tip: flour(面粉) 和 flower(花) 同音——面粉开出面包花。

examples.en: Heat some oil in the pan.
The eggs are in the pan.

mnemonic.tip: pancake 就是用 pan 摊出来的 cake。

examples.en: The soup is cooking in a big pot.
Grandma made a pot of tea.

mnemonic.tip: 深锅是 pot，平底锅是 pan；a pot of tea 一壶茶。

examples.en: The children played in the sand.
The sand is hot under my feet.

mnemonic.tip: sandwich 传说和 sand 无关，但 sand castle(沙堡)真是沙子堆的。

examples.en: We collected shells on the beach.
The turtle hid inside its shell.

mnemonic.tip: she+ll：小美人鱼 she 最爱捡 shell。

examples.en: There are goldfish in the garden pond.
Frogs sing by the pond at night.
examples.zh: 夜里青蛙在池塘边鸣叫。

mnemonic.tip: pond 比 lake 小：公园小池塘是 pond，大湖才是 lake。

examples.en: There is a hole in my sock.
The mouse ran into a hole in the wall.

mnemonic.tip: hole(洞) 和 whole(整个) 同音——整个(whole)袜子就一个洞(hole)。

examples.en: The cat sleeps in the warm sunshine.
examples.zh: 猫在温暖的阳光下睡觉。

examples.en: We had two weeks of sunshine at the seaside.
examples.zh: 我们在海边享受了两周的阳光。

mnemonic.tip: sun(太阳)+shine(照耀)→太阳照下来的光，就是阳光。

examples.en: Our dog had four puppies!
examples.zh: 我们的狗生了四只小狗！

examples.en: The puppy follows me everywhere.

mnemonic.tip: 小狗 puppy、小猫 kitten——动物宝宝有专属名字。

examples.en: The kitten is playing with a ball of wool.
She found a kitten in the garden.
examples.zh: 她在花园里发现了一只小猫。

mnemonic.tip: kitten 里有 kit(小工具)：小小一只的猫就是 kitten。

examples.en: My goldfish swims round and round.
examples.zh: 我的金鱼游啊游转圈圈。

examples.en: Feed the goldfish once a day.

mnemonic.tip: gold(金)+fish(鱼)→金色的鱼，就是金鱼。

examples.en: We built a big snowman in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们在花园里堆了个大雪人。

examples.en: The snowman has a carrot nose.

mnemonic.tip: snow(雪)+man(人)→雪堆的人；搭配 build/make a snowman。

examples.en: The Earth is our planet.
How many planets go around the sun?
examples.zh: 有多少颗行星绕着太阳转？

mnemonic.tip: planet 里有 plan：行星按"计划好的"轨道绕太阳转。

examples.en: He hit the ball with the bat.
Bats fly out at night.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：棒球棒和蝙蝠——蝙蝠侠 Batman 两个都占了。

examples.en: I got a new tennis racket.
Hold the racket with both hands.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"拉克特"：网球拍一挥"啪"一声。

examples.en: The ball went over the net.
The fisherman pulled in his net.

mnemonic.tip: internet(互联网)里的 net：把世界连起来的大网。

examples.en: She won a gold medal in swimming.
The runners got medals at the end.
examples.zh: 赛跑选手最后都得到了奖牌。

mnemonic.tip: medal(奖牌) 和 metal(金属) 音近：奖牌就是金属做的。

examples.en: The girls are jumping over a rope.
Tie the boat with a rope.

mnemonic.tip: skip rope / jump rope 跳绳；rope 比 string(细线)粗。

examples.en: The Chinese flag is red with five stars.
examples.zh: 中国国旗是红色的，上面有五颗星。

examples.en: We raise the flag every Monday morning.

mnemonic.tip: raise the flag 升旗；national flag 国旗。

examples.en: There are eleven candles on the cake.
Blow out the candles and make a wish!

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"看斗"：生日会上大家都看着蜡烛斗着谁先吹灭。

examples.en: Danger! Deep water!
The sign warns of danger ahead.

mnemonic.tip: 警示牌上的大字 DANGER；形容词是 dangerous。

examples.en: It's a fact that fish can't close their eyes.
The book is full of fun facts about space.
examples.zh: 这本书里全是有趣的太空小知识。

mnemonic.tip: in fact 事实上；fun facts 趣味小知识。

examples.en: We watched fireworks on New Year's Eve.
The fireworks lit up the night sky.

mnemonic.tip: fire(火)+works(作品)→火做的艺术品，就是烟花。

examples.en: What do you want to be in the future?
Robots will help us more in the future.
examples.zh: 未来机器人会帮我们更多。

mnemonic.tip: in the future 在未来；将来时态就叫 future tense。

examples.en: Can you play a musical instrument?
The piano is a big instrument.

mnemonic.tip: KET 口语常问 Do you play any instruments? 提前准备答案。

examples.en: This machine makes ice cream.
Put a coin in the machine for a drink.
examples.zh: 往机器里投硬币买饮料。

mnemonic.tip: washing machine 洗衣机、cash machine 取款机——machine 家族。

examples.en: Dad has a meeting at nine.
The club meeting is in the library.
examples.zh: 社团会议在图书馆举行。

mnemonic.tip: meet(见面)+ing→大家见面商量事，就是开会。

examples.en: The king's palace has a hundred rooms.
examples.zh: 国王的宫殿有一百个房间。

examples.en: We visited the Summer Palace in Beijing.
examples.zh: 我们游览了北京颐和园。

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"派勒斯"：国王的派头全在宫殿里。

examples.en: Which part of the film did you like best?
examples.zh: 电影里你最喜欢哪一部分？

examples.en: I take part in the school choir.

mnemonic.tip: take part in 参加；part of 一部分。

examples.en: The cloud has the shape of a horse.
Circles and squares are shapes.

mnemonic.tip: in the shape of 呈…形状；keep in shape 保持身材。

examples.en: The band walked onto the stage.
I was nervous on stage at first.
examples.zh: 一开始在台上我很紧张。

mnemonic.tip: on stage 在台上；stage 也表示"阶段"。

examples.en: Add some sugar to the tea.
Two add three is five.

mnemonic.tip: add A to B 把A加到B里；数学加法就是 add。

examples.en: They are building a new school here.
examples.zh: 他们正在这里建一所新学校。

examples.en: We built a sand castle on the beach.
examples.zh: 我们在沙滩上堆了座沙堡。

mnemonic.tip: build→built→built；building(建筑物) 就是 build 出来的。

examples.en: Be careful not to burn your fingers.
The fire burnt all night.

mnemonic.tip: burn→burnt(英式)；饭烧糊了也是 burnt。

examples.en: The cat hid under the bed.
Where did you hide my present?
examples.zh: 你把我的礼物藏哪儿了？

mnemonic.tip: hide-and-seek 捉迷藏；hide→hid→hidden。

examples.en: I have my own bedroom now.
examples.zh: 我现在有自己的卧室了。

examples.en: They own a small restaurant.

mnemonic.tip: my own room 我自己的房间；on my own 独自。

examples.en: Let's share the last piece of cake.
examples.zh: 我们分吃最后一块蛋糕吧。

examples.en: I share a room with my brother.
examples.zh: 我和弟弟合住一个房间。

mnemonic.tip: share sth with sb 和某人分享；网上转发也叫 share。

examples.en: Don't worry. Everything will be fine.
Mum worries when I come home late.
examples.zh: 我回家晚了妈妈就担心。

mnemonic.tip: Don't worry! 别担心——安慰人的第一句；形容词 worried。

examples.en: Our team got ten points.
Don't point at people. It's not polite.
examples.zh: 别用手指人，那样不礼貌。

mnemonic.tip: 得分是 point，用手指是 point at——都是"点"。

examples.en: She is my best friend.
This is the best cake I've ever eaten!
examples.zh: 这是我吃过的最好吃的蛋糕！

mnemonic.tip: good→better→best；信末写 Best wishes 致以祝福。

examples.en: The lift is broken. Use the stairs.
Watch out for the broken glass!

mnemonic.tip: break 的过去分词当形容词：坏了就是 broken。

examples.en: The sky is clear tonight. Look at the stars!
examples.zh: 今晚天空晴朗，看那些星星！

examples.en: The teacher's explanation was very clear.

mnemonic.tip: clear water 清水、clear sky 晴空、Is that clear? 明白了吗？

examples.en: The bus is crowded in the morning.
The beach gets crowded in August.

mnemonic.tip: crowd(人群)+ed→挤满人群的，就是拥挤的。

examples.en: Your English is excellent!
The food at the party was excellent.

mnemonic.tip: 老师批作业的最高评价：Excellent! 优秀！

examples.en: The Great Wall is famous all over the world.
This town is famous for its noodles.

mnemonic.tip: fame(名声)+ous→有名声的；be famous for 以…出名。

examples.en: The new library is very modern.
I like modern music more than old songs.
examples.zh: 比起老歌我更喜欢现代音乐。

mnemonic.tip: 谐音"摩登"：上海话"摩登"就是 modern 的音译。

examples.en: It's a perfect day for a picnic.
examples.zh: 今天是野餐的完美日子。

examples.en: Her spelling test was perfect.
examples.zh: 她的拼写测验得了满分。

mnemonic.tip: Perfect! 完美！——表示"太好了"的口语高频赞叹。

examples.en: Football is popular all over the world.
examples.zh: 足球在全世界都很受欢迎。

examples.en: She is popular because she is kind.

mnemonic.tip: pop music 就是 popular music 的简称：流行=受欢迎。

examples.en: Is it possible to finish today?
Come as early as possible.

mnemonic.tip: as soon as possible 尽快(ASAP)；if possible 如果可能。

examples.en: It's impossible to finish in five minutes.
examples.zh: 五分钟内完成是不可能的。

examples.en: Nothing is impossible if you try hard.
examples.zh: 努力尝试，没有什么不可能。

mnemonic.tip: im(否定)+possible→不可能；im- 常加在 p 开头的词前。

examples.en: The moon is big and round tonight.
We walked round the lake.

mnemonic.tip: round 圆的/绕圈；all year round 一年到头。

examples.en: I heard a strange noise last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我听到了奇怪的声音。

examples.en: That's strange. My keys were here!
examples.zh: 真奇怪，我的钥匙刚才还在这儿！

mnemonic.tip: stranger(陌生人) 就是 strange 的人——陌生所以奇怪。

examples.en: He ate the whole pizza by himself!
examples.zh: 他一个人吃了一整个披萨！

examples.en: We spent the whole day at the beach.
examples.zh: 我们在海滩待了一整天。

mnemonic.tip: whole(整个) 和 hole(洞) 同音；the whole day 一整天。

examples.en: Sorry, you have the wrong number.
What's wrong? You look worried.
examples.zh: 怎么了？你看起来很担心。

mnemonic.tip: What's wrong? 怎么了？——关心别人的高频句；w 不发音。

examples.en: My parents have a double room.
The word 'happy' has a double 'p'.
examples.zh: happy 这个词有两个 p。

mnemonic.tip: double room 双人间，single room 单人间——订酒店必备。

examples.en: She was unhappy about losing the game.
Why do you look so unhappy?
examples.zh: 你为什么看起来这么不开心？

mnemonic.tip: un(否定)+happy→不开心；un- 家族：unlucky、untidy。

examples.en: A careless mistake cost him two marks.
examples.zh: 一个粗心的错误让他丢了两分。

examples.en: Don't be careless with your spelling.

mnemonic.tip: care(细心)+less(没有)→没了细心，就是粗心；-less 表"无"。

examples.en: Do we have enough eggs for the cake?
The water isn't warm enough for swimming.

mnemonic.tip: enough+名词(enough time)；形容词+enough(big enough)——位置不同。

examples.en: The sea is two kilometres away.
Put your toys away before bed.

mnemonic.tip: far away 很远；go away 走开；put away 收起来。

examples.en: Come here and look at this!
Here is your change.

mnemonic.tip: Here you are. 给你——递东西时必说。

examples.en: The library? You can walk there in five minutes.
examples.zh: 图书馆？走五分钟就到了。

examples.en: There are forty students in my class.

mnemonic.tip: there is/are 有…；over there 在那边。

examples.en: We must leave now, or we'll be late.
examples.zh: 我们现在必须出发，否则要迟到了。

examples.en: What are you doing now?

mnemonic.tip: right now 立刻马上；看到 now 常用现在进行时。

examples.en: First do your homework, then play.
See you at six, then!

mnemonic.tip: then(然后) 和 than(比) 拼写易混：e 是时间，a 是比较。

examples.en: There is a football match on TV tonight.
Let's eat out tonight!

mnemonic.tip: to+night→"到今夜"，就是今晚；同类 today、tomorrow。

examples.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.
Is dinner ready yet?

mnemonic.tip: not yet 还没有；yet 常放否定句和疑问句句尾。

examples.en: Would you like anything else?
Let's ask someone else for help.

mnemonic.tip: else 跟在疑问词和 something/anyone 后：what else、anything else。

examples.en: Is anybody home?
I didn't see anybody in the park.
examples.zh: 我在公园里没看到任何人。

mnemonic.tip: any(任何)+body(人)→任何人；多用于疑问句和否定句。

examples.en: Everybody likes her.
Good morning, everybody!

mnemonic.tip: every(每个)+body(人)→每个人；后面动词用单数。

examples.en: Somebody left a bag on the bus.
examples.zh: 有人把包落在公交车上了。

examples.en: I need somebody to help me.

mnemonic.tip: some(某个)+body(人)→某人；多用于肯定句。

examples.en: There was nowhere to sit.
My keys are nowhere in the house.
examples.zh: 我的钥匙在家里哪儿都找不到。

mnemonic.tip: no(没有)+where(哪里)→哪里都没有；对比 somewhere、everywhere。

examples.en: He made this cake himself.
examples.zh: 这个蛋糕是他自己做的。

examples.en: Tom looked at himself in the mirror.
examples.zh: 汤姆照了照镜子里的自己。

mnemonic.tip: him(他)+self(自己)→他自己；-self 家族的一员。

examples.en: She painted the wall herself.
Mary is proud of herself.

mnemonic.tip: her(她)+self(自己)→她自己。

examples.en: Did you draw this picture yourself?
examples.zh: 这幅画是你自己画的吗？

examples.en: Please help yourself to some fruit.

mnemonic.tip: your(你的)+self(自己)→你自己；help yourself 请自便。

examples.en: The cat washed itself.
The door closed by itself.

mnemonic.tip: it(它)+self(自己)→它自己；by itself 自动地。

examples.en: We cleaned the classroom ourselves.
examples.zh: 教室是我们自己打扫的。

examples.en: We really enjoyed ourselves at the party.
examples.zh: 我们在聚会上玩得很开心。

mnemonic.tip: our(我们的)+selves(自己们)→我们自己；复数 self 变 selves。

examples.en: The children dressed themselves.
examples.zh: 孩子们自己穿好了衣服。

examples.en: They built the tree house themselves.

mnemonic.tip: them(他们)+selves(自己们)→他们自己。

examples.en: This pencil is mine.
Your bike is newer than mine.

mnemonic.tip: my 的独立形式：my pencil = 这支 pencil is mine，后面不加名词。

examples.en: Is this umbrella yours?
My bag is black, and yours is blue.
examples.zh: 我的包是黑色的，你的是蓝色的。

mnemonic.tip: your+s→你的东西；信末常写 Yours, Tom。

examples.en: The red coat is hers.
My phone is older than hers.

mnemonic.tip: her+s→她的东西，后面不加名词。

examples.en: That classroom is ours.
Their garden is bigger than ours.
examples.zh: 他们的花园比我们的大。

mnemonic.tip: our+s→我们的东西，后面不加名词。

examples.en: The blue car is theirs.
examples.zh: 那辆蓝色的车是他们的。

examples.en: Our house is next to theirs.

mnemonic.tip: their+s→他们的东西，后面不加名词。

examples.en: You can sit on either side.
I don't like coffee, and Tom doesn't either.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢咖啡，汤姆也不喜欢。

mnemonic.tip: either…or… 或者…或者…；否定句句尾的"也"用 either。

examples.en: Neither answer is right.
Neither of my parents can swim.

mnemonic.tip: n(否定)+either(任一)→任一个都不→两者都不；neither…nor…。

examples.en: None of the shops were open.
I wanted some milk, but there was none left.
examples.zh: 我想喝牛奶，但一点也没剩。

mnemonic.tip: no+one 合体→一个也没有；none of 后接名词或代词。

examples.en: I have several good friends at school.
examples.zh: 我在学校有好几个好朋友。

examples.en: She called me several times yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天给我打了好几次电话。

mnemonic.tip: 开头像 seven→大约几个（三到七个）的数量。

examples.en: We have plenty of time before the film.
examples.zh: 离电影开场我们还有很多时间。

examples.en: There is plenty of food in the fridge.

mnemonic.tip: plenty of = a lot of，够用还有余。

examples.en: I have already finished my homework.
The bus had already left when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到的时候公交车已经开走了。

mnemonic.tip: al(all 全)+ready(准备好)→全都准备好了→已经。

examples.en: We do daily exercise at school.
This shop opens daily at nine.

mnemonic.tip: day(天)+ly→每天的；同类：weekly 每周的。

examples.en: The car moved forward slowly.
I'm looking forward to the summer holiday.

mnemonic.tip: for(向前)+ward(方向)→向前；look forward to 期待。

examples.en: There is a garden in front of the house.
Please sit at the front of the class.

mnemonic.tip: in front of 在…前面；front door 前门。

examples.en: Don't stand near the edge of the pool.
Put the cup away from the edge of the table.
examples.zh: 把杯子放得离桌边远一点。

mnemonic.tip: 桌子的沿、悬崖的边都叫 edge：the edge of the table。

examples.en: A big crowd watched the football match.
examples.zh: 一大群人观看了足球赛。

examples.en: We lost each other in the crowd.

mnemonic.tip: crowded(拥挤的)去掉 ed→crowd 挤在一起的人群。

examples.en: The party was a big surprise for Dad.
examples.zh: 这个聚会给了爸爸一个大大的惊喜。

examples.en: The news surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 这个消息让所有人都很吃惊。

mnemonic.tip: a surprise party 惊喜派对；形容词 surprised 感到吃惊的。

examples.en: Can you keep a secret?
They have a secret plan for Mum's birthday.
examples.zh: 他们为妈妈的生日准备了一个秘密计划。

mnemonic.tip: keep a secret 保守秘密；secret plan 秘密计划。

examples.en: My alarm rings at seven every morning.
examples.zh: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。

examples.en: I forgot to set the alarm last night.

mnemonic.tip: alarm clock 闹钟——一到点就"啊(a)"地叫(larm)你起床。

examples.en: The waiter carried the drinks on a tray.
examples.zh: 服务员用托盘端着饮料。

examples.en: Put your dirty plates on the tray, please.
examples.zh: 请把脏盘子放到托盘上。

mnemonic.tip: 食堂打饭用 tray 端着 plate 和 cup 走。

examples.en: Would you like a slice of pizza?
Mum cut the bread into thin slices.
examples.zh: 妈妈把面包切成了薄片。

mnemonic.tip: sl+ice：切得像 ice(冰)一样薄的一片→slice。

examples.en: The chef cooked a wonderful dinner.
examples.zh: 大厨做了一顿丰盛的晚餐。

examples.en: My uncle is a chef in a big hotel.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是一家大酒店的厨师。

mnemonic.tip: chef 读作 /ʃef/，谐音"谁夫"——大厨是谁家的功夫？

examples.en: Children must come with a grown-up.
The grown-ups talked while we played.

mnemonic.tip: grow 长大→grown-up 已经长大了的人→成年人。

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our show!
examples.zh: 女士们先生们，欢迎观看我们的演出！

examples.en: The old gentleman opened the door for us.
examples.zh: 那位老先生为我们开了门。

mnemonic.tip: gentle(温和有礼)+man(男士)→绅士。

examples.en: He climbed the ladder to clean the window.
Be careful! The ladder is very old.

mnemonic.tip: ladder 谐音"拉的"——爬梯子要手拉着一步步上。

examples.en: The dog jumped over the fence.
Dad painted the garden fence white.
examples.zh: 爸爸把花园的栅栏刷成了白色。

mnemonic.tip: defence(防守)里藏着 fence——围栏就是用来防护的。

examples.en: The train went through a long tunnel.
examples.zh: 火车穿过了一条长长的隧道。

examples.en: It was dark inside the tunnel.

mnemonic.tip: 火车过山不爬山，走山肚子里的 tunnel。

examples.en: Tie the box with a piece of string.
examples.zh: 用一根绳子把盒子捆上。

examples.en: The kite is at the end of a long string.

mnemonic.tip: st+ring：绳子绕一圈就成了 ring(环)。

examples.en: Fix the poster to the wall with tape.
examples.zh: 用胶带把海报固定在墙上。

examples.en: Grandpa still has some old music tapes.
examples.zh: 爷爷还留着一些旧音乐磁带。

examples.en: This is my grandma's recipe for apple pie.
examples.zh: 这是我奶奶的苹果派食谱。

examples.en: The recipe says we need two eggs.
examples.zh: 食谱上说我们需要两个鸡蛋。

mnemonic.tip: recipe 上写着材料和步骤，照着做就能出菜。

examples.en: Don't open the door to strangers.
A stranger asked me the way to the station.
examples.zh: 一个陌生人向我打听去车站的路。

mnemonic.tip: strange(陌生的)+er(人)→陌生人。

examples.en: We had lunch at midday.
examples.zh: 我们中午十二点吃了午饭。

examples.en: The sun is hottest at midday.

mnemonic.tip: mid(中间)+day(白天)→白天的正中间→正午。

examples.en: This castle is over three centuries old.
examples.zh: 这座城堡有三百多年历史了。

examples.en: We live in the twenty-first century.
examples.zh: 我们生活在二十一世纪。

mnemonic.tip: cent(百)+ury→一百年就是一个世纪；同根：percent 百分之。

examples.en: A small river runs through the valley.
examples.zh: 一条小河从山谷中流过。

examples.en: The village in the valley is very quiet.
examples.zh: 山谷里的村庄非常安静。

mnemonic.tip: V 字开头——两山之间的 V 形凹地就是 valley。

examples.en: We caught small fish in the stream.
The stream runs down the hill.

mnemonic.tip: 开头的 s 弯弯曲曲，像小溪流过的样子。

examples.en: The thunder was very loud last night.
My dog is afraid of thunder.

mnemonic.tip: thunder and lightning：先见 lightning 后闻 thunder。

examples.en: Lightning lit up the whole sky.
We saw lightning before we heard the thunder.
examples.zh: 我们先看到闪电，然后才听到雷声。

mnemonic.tip: light(光)+ning→天空中划过的大亮光→闪电。

examples.en: I can't sleep in this heat.
The heat of the sun made us tired.
examples.zh: 烈日的高温让我们很疲惫。

mnemonic.tip: h+eat：heat 里藏着 eat——天太热，饭都不想 eat。

examples.en: The total of the bill was fifty yuan.
There are thirty students in total.

mnemonic.tip: in total 总共；total price 总价。

examples.en: We sat in the front row at the cinema.
examples.zh: 我们坐在电影院的第一排。

examples.en: There is a row of trees along the road.

mnemonic.tip: 电影院的座位一 row 一 row 排开；in a row 排成一排。

examples.en: Mind the step when you go in.
The baby took her first steps today.
examples.zh: 宝宝今天迈出了她的第一步。

mnemonic.tip: step by step 一步一步来；mind the step 小心台阶。

examples.en: Draw a triangle and a circle.
examples.zh: 画一个三角形和一个圆形。

examples.en: The roof looks like a big triangle.
examples.zh: 屋顶看起来像个大三角形。

mnemonic.tip: tri(三)+angle(角)→三个角的形状→三角形。
